flushing of the portal vein with saline can be used to avoid contact of AAV vectors with neutralizing antibodies present in the blood.
saline flushing can be used to remove NAbs and other inhibitory molecules in the blood and thus increase the efficacy of vector-mediated gene transfer in the liver, especially for AAV vectors.
